events.name: Drag queen Kareoke
events.description:
The lights dim low over the Lounge, a mic waits under a single spotlight, and the air smells like spilled cocktails and nerve. This is karaoke — but the queens run the show. Thee Liqour holds court as host, weaving between sets with the kind of energy that makes strangers scream the words to songs they forgot they loved.

You sing. They perform. Sometimes both happen at once, and that's when it gets good — a queen sliding into frame mid-chorus, stealing your spotlight and giving it right back with interest. Open format means anyone can grab the mic, so come ready to belt it out, off-key and unbothered, while the room cheers you on like you're the headliner.

Between sets, expect jaw-dropping numbers that come out of nowhere — full glam, full drama, gone before you can catch your breath. Bring cash for tips because these queens work for it, and they deserve every dollar. The drinks are cold, the crowd's loud, and the night belongs to whoever's brave enough to take the stage.

This isn't polite karaoke. It's a full sensory hit — sequins catching the light, bass thumping under ballads, and a room that feels like one big dare. Come sing. Come watch. Come tip. Just come.

events.name: VIDA AMORE DIVAS SHOW: LA MAS DRAGA

Llega desde las 7:30 PM para agarrar mesa y pedir tu primera ronda: el lounge se llena rápido cuando hay corona de por medio. La transmisión arranca a las 8:00 PM en pantalla grande — cada look, cada lip sync, cada sorpresa y el momento de la coronación, vividos en comunidad, con aplausos, gritos y algún drama de sobremesa incluido.

Apenas se conozca la ganadora, la fiesta no se detiene: el Vida Amore Divas Show toma el escenario para la celebración en vivo, arrancando justo después de la final o, a más tardar, a las 10:15 PM. Drag, actuación y esa energía de after-party que solo Azúcar sabe armar.

events.name: Amature Drag Pageant
events.description:
Three rounds. One crown. Zero mercy — pero con mucho amor. Azúcar's Main Floor turns into the pageant runway of your dreams on August 19th, as Abele Fantasy takes the mic to host the Amature Drag Pageant, an open-category showcase for talent, glamour, and belleza in every shape it comes in.

Round one: talent — sing it, lip-sync it, dance it, act it, we don't care, just bring the fuego. Round two: ballroom / gown portion, gender-inclusive por diseño, because elegance isn't one silhouette — wear the gown, the suit, the fantasy, whatever makes you feel like royalty. Round three: beauty, defined on your own terms, drag como tú lo entiendes, tu belleza, tu regla.

The room will be electric — categoría is served, the crowd is loud, and every contestant walks in a legend already. Sponsors are stacking a prize basket loaded with goodies, fresh makeup, and — of course — the crown itself, waiting for whoever brings the most heart and heat to that stage.

Grab a seat, grab a drink, and get ready to scream for your favorites. Whether you're competing or cheering, este es tu momento — full glam, full drama, full corazón.

events.name: Les-Be-Emo
events.description:
Flannel up — Azúcar's Patio is going full distortion for Les-Be-Emo, a mini music festival built for anyone who still cries to Alice in Chains and screams to Metallica. Three bands, one heavy night: Summerache rolls in from Spokane with their moody, fuzzed-out sound, Porch Cat brings the Tri-Cities favorite energy fans already know and love, and Moonstruck rounds it out with riffs that hit somewhere between nostalgia and noise.

DJ Dea holds down the transitions and keeps the crowd loose between sets — because even grunge nights need a groove. Expect combat boots next to cocktail glasses, sunset turning to string lights, and a patio crowd that's equal parts mosh-curious and margarita-in-hand.

This one's for the ones who still know every word to '90s alt-rock anthems and the ones who just want to feel something loud. Come let your inner grunge kid out — Azúcar's got the stage, the sound, and the drinks ready.

events.name: Les-Be-Emo Drag Show
events.description:
Dig out your studded belt and your saddest playlist — the Patio is about to smell like Hot Topic and heartbreak. Les-Be-Emo Drag Show takes everything you loved (and cringed at) about 2000s-2010s emo and grunge and hands it straight to our queens, who are going to wear it, weep it, and wreck it in the best way possible.

Thee Ember Rexia Romanoff hosts the chaos, guiding you through a night of lip-syncs and looks pulled straight from your old MySpace profile — think smudged black eyeliner, band tees ripped just right, and choruses that hit like your first breakup. This is drag with a lump in its throat and a fist in the air.

Come for the nostalgia, stay because you suddenly, inexplicably, want to run away from home again. Grab a drink, grab a friend, and let the night talk you into (or out of) texting your ex — no judgment either way. Azúcar's Patio is the setting, angst is the mood, and everybody's invited to feel sixteen again.

events.name: Drag Brunch de Reinas
events.description:
Summer just got sinful, mamis. Drag Brunch de Reinas struts onto the Main Floor with four reinas ready to work every inch of that stage. Cynthia Marche serves gowns that could stop traffic. Frívola Montes de Oca brings the chaos and the comedy. Ana Deborah owns the room like she pays rent here. Abele Fantasy? That body alone deserves a round of applause — and a mimosa refill.

Doors crack open at 9:30am. VIP queens meet-and-greet runs 10–11am — get close, get a photo, get flirty before the show even starts. Brunch pours from 10am to 2pm, mimosas flowing like it's nobody's business. The main show — full drag, full glam, full innuendo — hits 11am to 1pm. Then photos with the queens from 1–2pm, so you can prove to your friends this actually happened.

Stick around for the after party, 2–4pm, when brunch energy melts into afternoon chaos — the good kind. Bottomless drinks, bold queens, and a room that gets hotter by the hour. This is summer, Latinx-style: bright, filthy fun, and completely unforgettable.

Get your tickets now, reinas — this brunch sells out faster than a compliment from Frívola.
